fusions.name: Slack Line
fusions.desc: Pays out a slack line of mesh up to 5 tiles that deals 7 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and slows the target by 30% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Slow Sinking
fusions.desc: Settles your full weight on an enemy at or below 30% health and lets your mesh sink it, dealing 22 damage and leaving it [Soaked] and 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Together
fusions.desc: Draws the ally who needs it most into your drifting mesh, restoring 3 health a second to them for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Return
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your mesh drifts slack back to you and you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
